---
title: "Cellular communities in bone-marrow samples (all cell types)"
author: "LazDaria, ArthurDondi"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  workflowr::wflow_html
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: inline
params:
  input: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET2_INPUT", "/mnt/data/input_all")
  output: !r Sys.getenv("MAPMET2_OUTPUT", "/mnt/data/output_mapmet2")
  # TRUE: all BM samples incl. the normal control BM; FALSE: NB-patient samples only
  include_controls: TRUE
  # Number of communities cut from the sample dendrogram
  n_communities: 2
  # Samples with fewer cells are left out (their composition is too noisy)
  min_cells: 100
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
variant  <- if (isTRUE(params$include_controls)) "with_controls" else "without_controls"
plot_dir <- file.path(params$output, "plots/05.1_BM_cellularcomm", variant)
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) {
  dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

date_prefix <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

# Save a plot (ggplot / patchwork / grob) as PDF or PNG, by file extension
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  full_path <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0(date_prefix, "_", filename))
  if (inherits(plot_obj, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(full_path, plot = plot_obj, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi,
           bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
  } else {
    if (grepl("\\.png$", full_path)) png(full_path, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi)
    else pdf(full_path, width = width, height = height)
    grid::grid.draw(plot_obj)
    dev.off()
  }
  message("Saved: ", full_path)
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 300,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6
)
```

# Cellular communities in bone-marrow samples {#bm-cellularcomm}

Adapted from MapMetSC's `05.1_PT_DE_cellularcomm.Rmd`, which clusters diagnostic primary tumors on their tumor cell-type composition. Here we cluster **bone-marrow samples on the composition of all their cell types**. This report is the variant **`r variant`**: `r if (isTRUE(params$include_controls)) "all BM samples, including the normal control BM" else "the NB-patient BM samples only (DE, T1, T2, REL), without the normal control BM"`. The combined figure stacks the sample dendrogram, the all-cell-type composition used for the clustering, the BM sample type (timepoint) and the patient-level genetic / clinical tracks, and the tumor, immune and metacluster compositions.

## Load libraries
<details>
   <summary>Load libraries</summary>

```{r load-libraries}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdendro)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)
```
</details>

## Read data
We load the phenotyped single-cell data from [chapter 4](04_phenotyping.html) and keep one row per cell with its sample (`fm_id`) and the sample- and patient-level metadata.

```{r read-data}
spe <- readRDS(file.path(params$output, "spe_04_phenotyping.rds"))

for (mapmet_cc_path in c("analysis/00_MapMet_color_code.R", "00_MapMet_color_code.R", "../analysis/00_MapMet_color_code.R"))
  if (file.exists(mapmet_cc_path)) { source(mapmet_cc_path); break }

col_celltype    <- metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_celltype_ordered
col_metacluster <- metadata(spe)$color_vectors$col_metacluster
ct_levels       <- levels(spe$celltype_ordered)

cells <- as.data.frame(colData(spe))[, c("fm_id", "patient_id", "timepoint", "celltype", "metacluster",
                                         "MYCN_amp", "X1p_loss", "progression", "age_diag")]
cells$celltype <- factor(cells$celltype, levels = ct_levels)
if (!isTRUE(params$include_controls)) cells <- cells[cells$timepoint != "control", ]
rm(spe); invisible(gc())

# Samples with too few cells are left out
n_per_sample <- table(cells$fm_id)
too_small    <- names(n_per_sample)[n_per_sample < params$min_cells]
if (length(too_small))
  message(length(too_small), " sample(s) with < ", params$min_cells, " cells left out: ",
          paste(too_small, collapse = ", "))
cells <- cells[!cells$fm_id %in% too_small, ]

# Immune compartment (as in MapMetSC: not tumor, mesenchymal or other)
immune_meta <- setdiff(unique(cells$metacluster), c("tumor", "mesenchymal", "other"))
```

The data contain `r length(unique(cells$fm_id))` samples (`r length(too_small)` left out with fewer than `r params$min_cells` cells).

## Sample-level metadata

```{r sample-metadata}
# MYCN / 1p loss / progression -> yes / no / het (NA for the controls)
recode_ynh <- function(x) dplyr::recode(as.character(x),
  "1" = "yes", "0" = "no", "2" = "het", "9" = "NA",
  "MNA" = "yes", "nMNA" = "no", "het" = "het", "unknown" = "NA",
  "Prog" = "yes", "NoProg" = "no", "yes" = "yes", "no" = "no",
  .default = "NA", .missing = "NA")

# Shannon entropy of a composition (heterogeneity)
shannon <- function(n) { p <- n[n > 0] / sum(n); if (!length(p)) NA_real_ else -sum(p * log(p)) }

samples <- cells %>%
  group_by(fm_id) %>%
  summarise(
    patient_id = first(patient_id),
    timepoint  = first(timepoint),
    mycn       = recode_ynh(first(MYCN_amp)),
    loss1p     = recode_ynh(first(X1p_loss)),
    prog       = recode_ynh(first(progression)),
    age_diag   = as.numeric(first(age_diag)),
    n_cells    = n(),
    pct_tumor  = 100 * mean(metacluster == "tumor"),
    het_tumor  = shannon(table(droplevels(celltype[metacluster == "tumor"]))),
    het_immune = shannon(table(droplevels(celltype[metacluster %in% immune_meta]))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()
ctrl <- samples$timepoint == "control"
samples[ctrl, c("mycn", "loss1p", "prog")] <- NA   # not applicable to the controls
rownames(samples) <- samples$fm_id

tp_levels <- intersect(TIMEPOINT_LEVELS, unique(samples$timepoint))
samples$timepoint <- factor(samples$timepoint, levels = tp_levels)
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(timepoint = samples$timepoint), responseName = "n_samples"))
```

## Cluster cellular communities

We cluster the samples on their **all-cell-type** composition. Per-sample proportions are compositional, so - as in MapMetSC - we add a per-sample pseudocount (`CLR_PSEUDO` cells) and apply a centered log-ratio (CLR) transformation before clustering with Euclidean distance and Ward.D2 linkage. The dendrogram is cut into `r params$n_communities` communities, numbered by size (community 1 is the largest).

```{r cluster-communities}
set.seed(20231103)

distance <- "euclidean"
linkage  <- "ward.D2"
CLR_PSEUDO <- 0.5

counts_ct <- as.matrix(table(factor(cells$fm_id, levels = samples$fm_id), cells$celltype))
counts_ct <- counts_ct[, colSums(counts_ct) > 0, drop = FALSE]
prop_ct   <- counts_ct / rowSums(counts_ct)
cmat_adj  <- sweep(prop_ct, 1, CLR_PSEUDO / rowSums(counts_ct), "+")
clr_df    <- t(apply(cmat_adj, 1, function(x) log(x) - mean(log(x))))

hc <- hclust(dist(clr_df, method = distance), method = linkage)

# Reorder leaves so the larger community sorts to the left (branch swaps only)
comm_membership   <- cutree(hc, k = params$n_communities)
comm_sizes        <- table(comm_membership)
comm_rank_by_size <- rank(-as.integer(comm_sizes), ties.method = "first")
names(comm_rank_by_size) <- names(comm_sizes)
hc <- as.hclust(reorder(as.dendrogram(hc), wts = unname(comm_rank_by_size[as.character(comm_membership)]),
                        agglo.FUN = mean))

# Community numbers by size: the largest is community 1
samples$community <- factor(unname(comm_rank_by_size[as.character(cutree(hc, k = params$n_communities)[samples$fm_id])]))
clustered_samples <- rownames(clr_df)[hc$order]
community_levels  <- levels(samples$community)

knitr::kable(as.data.frame.matrix(table(community = samples$community, timepoint = samples$timepoint)),
             caption = "Samples per community and BM sample type")
```

We save each sample's community with its metadata for the downstream analyses.

```{r save-communities}
out_tab <- samples[clustered_samples, ]
write.csv(out_tab, file.path(params$output, paste0("communities_BM_", variant, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(out_tab, file.path(params$output, paste0("communities_BM_", variant, ".rds")))
```

## Dendrogram

```{r dendrogram, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
p_dend_plain <- ggdendrogram(hc, labels = length(clustered_samples) <= 80) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Samples clustered on all cell types (CLR, ", distance, ", ", linkage, ")"))
p_dend_plain
save_plot(p_dend_plain, "dendrogram.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
```

## Summary statistics per community

Discrete sample metadata per community (pie charts) - the BM sample type and the patient-level MYCN amplification, 1p loss and progression (not applicable to the controls):

```{r piecharts, fig.height=8, fig.width=7}
pie_vars <- list(timepoint = list(title = "BM sample", cols = COL_TIMEPOINT),
                 mycn      = list(title = "MYCN amp.", cols = COL_YNH),
                 loss1p    = list(title = "1p loss",   cols = COL_YNH),
                 prog      = list(title = "progression", cols = COL_YNH))
pie_list <- lapply(names(pie_vars), function(v) {
  d <- samples[!is.na(samples[[v]]), ] %>% count(community, value = as.character(.data[[v]]))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = value)) +
    geom_col(position = "fill") +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    facet_grid(. ~ community) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pie_vars[[v]]$cols, name = pie_vars[[v]]$title) +
    theme_void()
})
p_pie <- wrap_plots(pie_list, ncol = 1)
p_pie
save_plot(p_pie, "piecharts_metadata.pdf", width = 7, height = 8)
```

Continuous sample metadata per community (Kruskal-Wallis p-value in each title): the tumor-cell fraction, the tumor and immune heterogeneity (Shannon entropy of the cell-type composition within the compartment) and the age at diagnosis.

```{r boxplots, fig.height=4, fig.width=12}
cont_vars <- c(pct_tumor = "% tumor cells", het_tumor = "tumor heterogeneity",
               het_immune = "immune heterogeneity", age_diag = "age at diagnosis [months]")
community_palette <- setNames(viridisLite::viridis(max(8, length(community_levels)))[seq_along(community_levels)],
                              community_levels)
box_list <- lapply(names(cont_vars), function(v) {
  d <- samples[!is.na(samples[[v]]), ]
  p_kw <- if (length(unique(d$community)) > 1) signif(kruskal.test(d[[v]] ~ d$community)$p.value, 2) else NA
  ggplot(d, aes(community, .data[[v]], fill = community)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = community_palette, guide = "none") +
    labs(title = paste0(cont_vars[[v]], "\np = ", p_kw), x = "community", y = NULL) +
    theme_classic() + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9))
})
p_box <- wrap_plots(box_list, nrow = 1)
p_box
save_plot(p_box, "boxplots_metadata.pdf", width = 12, height = 4)
```

## Combined figure (stacked panels)

As in MapMetSC's Fig 3a, the panels share the dendrogram sample order, with a blank spacer column between communities: dendrogram, all-cell-type composition (the clustering input), BM sample type and genetic / clinical tracks, tumor cell types (within the tumor cells), immune cell types (within the immune cells) and metaclusters.

```{r combined-figure, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
X_EXPAND <- expansion(add = 0.5)

# ---- Spacer columns between communities ----
comm_seq     <- as.character(samples[clustered_samples, "community"])
N            <- length(clustered_samples)
boundary_idx <- which(comm_seq[-1] != comm_seq[-N])
lev_spaced   <- clustered_samples
for (b in rev(seq_along(boundary_idx)))
  lev_spaced <- append(lev_spaced, paste0("__gap__", b), after = boundary_idx[b])
M        <- length(lev_spaced)
remap_x  <- function(v) v + vapply(v, function(z) sum(boundary_idx < z), numeric(1))
real_pos <- remap_x(seq_len(N))

# ---- Dendrogram on the spaced axis, with community labels ----
segs <- segment(dendro_data(hc, type = "rectangle"))
segs$x <- remap_x(segs$x); segs$xend <- remap_x(segs$xend)
h_root <- max(c(segs$y, segs$yend))
comm_label_df <- data.frame(
  x = vapply(community_levels, function(cc) mean(real_pos[comm_seq == cc]), numeric(1)),
  y = h_root * 1.08, label = community_levels)
p_dendro <- ggplot(segs) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  geom_text(data = comm_label_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, M + 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "Community") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5), plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 0, 2))

# ---- Composition barplots (% of the cells in the panel's subset) ----
comp_bar <- function(d, var, cols, legend_title) {
  tab <- d %>% count(fm_id, value = .data[[var]]) %>%
    group_by(fm_id) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(fm_id = factor(fm_id, levels = lev_spaced))
  ggplot(tab, aes(fm_id, pct, fill = value)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, expand = X_EXPAND) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, name = legend_title, drop = TRUE) +
    labs(y = "%") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 0, 2))
}
cells_k <- cells[cells$fm_id %in% clustered_samples, ]
p_all    <- comp_bar(cells_k, "celltype", col_celltype, "All cell types")
p_tumor  <- comp_bar(cells_k[cells_k$metacluster == "tumor", ], "celltype", col_celltype, "Tumor cell types")
p_immune <- comp_bar(cells_k[cells_k$metacluster %in% immune_meta, ], "celltype", col_celltype, "Immune cell types")
p_meta   <- comp_bar(cells_k, "metacluster", col_metacluster, "Metaclusters")

# ---- Metadata strips ----
meta_df <- samples[clustered_samples, ]
meta_df$fm_id <- factor(meta_df$fm_id, levels = lev_spaced)
strip <- function(var, cols, name) {
  ggplot(meta_df, aes(fm_id, 1, fill = as.character(.data[[var]]))) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, expand = X_EXPAND) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, name = name, na.value = "white") +
    labs(y = name) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 0, 2))
}
p_tp   <- strip("timepoint", COL_TIMEPOINT, "BM sample")
p_mycn <- strip("mycn",   COL_YNH, "MYCN amp.")
p_1p   <- strip("loss1p", COL_YNH, "1p loss")
p_prog <- strip("prog",   COL_YNH, "progression")

p_combined <- (p_dendro / p_all / p_tp / p_mycn / p_1p / p_prog / p_tumor / p_immune / p_meta) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(2, 4, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 3, 3, 3), guides = "collect")
p_combined
save_plot(p_combined, "combined_stacked.pdf", width = max(10, 4 + 0.05 * M), height = 14)
```
